limit: robot-link page jog drive cap (CONFIG_RL_DUTY_CAP, in firmware/robot-link/esp32/sdkconfig)
reason: Operator request: 'we need the signal to be able to go all the way up to 100% PWM'.
what_still_bounds_it: The FPGA's own PWM limit is 1000, the hx_safety default, which bridge_calibration does not override. Under the calibration profile now loaded, the FPGA forwards nonzero PWM only to an armed joint with a taught window, and refuses outward drive at a window edge. The page sends no windows, so it cannot arm the leg under this profile. A jog still needs a held button renewed every 80 ms, and the FPGA's 400 ms telemetry and 600 ms command leases still apply.
kconfig_default: Unchanged at 100. Only this bench's sdkconfig is raised.
